text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
A mysterious phenomenon...? When Cafe-san 
and I are together... you mean?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's just idle chatter. Say, haven't 
you felt anything lately? Something... 
supernatural, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...Come to think of it, the other day 
when I was having a coffee break with 
Cafe-san, my cup suddenly started rattling 
on its own..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oho...! Oh yes, that's it! Didn't you feel 
someone there? A presence that stirs your 
very instincts...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
N-Now that you mention it, I feel like I 
heard a mysterious whisper too...! ...Huh! 
C-Could it be—!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Could it be that the Saintess's power has 
awakened?!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah, surely it is! When wrapped in Cafe's 
gentle love, my heart feels so warm... 
Hehe♪

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm so glad to hear that... My 
'friend' is... very happy as well..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Met with you," was it? ..., almost 
noisy...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. Should I consider this a resonance 
phenomenon after all? If there's a causal 
relationship with the potential of 
Umamusume, then a new hypothesis—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
No, no, that was truly a great help, 
Desire-kun! Please continue to get along 
well with Cafe from here on out!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course♪ I'll be counting on you as 
always, Cafe-san.
